roles.title: Vice President
roles.description: The Vice President supports the President in the day-to-day running of TEDxNortheasternU London. You will help coordinate across teams, act as a key point of contact between officers and executive leadership, and step in where needed to keep operations running smoothly.
responsibilities: Support the President in overseeing officer teams
Act as a liaison between the Executive Committee and Officers
Assist in planning and running team meetings and check-ins
Step in to cover responsibilities across teams when needed
Help onboard new members and contribute to team culture
Support logistics planning for events and workshops
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Strong organisational and communication skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
Proactive, dependable, and a collaborative team player
Prior experience in a leadership or coordination role is a plus

roles.title: Secretary
roles.description: The Secretary keeps TEDxNortheasternU London organised and running efficiently. You will manage internal communications, maintain records, schedule meetings, and ensure the team stays aligned and informed across all stages of the event cycle.
responsibilities: Record and distribute minutes from all team meetings
Manage the team calendar and coordinate scheduling
Maintain organised records of key documents and decisions
Draft and circulate internal communications and updates
Support the Executive Committee with administrative tasks
Liaise with external contacts where required
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Highly organised with strong attention to detail
Excellent written communication skills
Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365
Reliable, punctual, and able to manage confidential information

roles.title: Marketing Officer
roles.description: The Marketing Officer drives awareness and engagement for TEDxNortheasternU London. You will plan and execute marketing campaigns, grow our audience on and off campus, and ensure the right people hear about our events and initiatives.
responsibilities: Develop and execute marketing campaigns for events and initiatives
Manage promotional materials in coordination with the Design team
Grow audience reach across digital and physical channels
Track marketing performance and report on key metrics
Represent TEDxNortheasternU London at campus events and fairs
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Passion for marketing, communications, or a related field
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience with marketing platforms, tools, or campaigns is a plus
Creative, data-aware, and audience-focused mindset

roles.title: Media Officer
roles.description: The Media Officer (Photography) is responsible for capturing the visual story of TEDxNortheasternU London. From workshop sessions to the flagship event, you will document our journey through photography, producing a library of high-quality images that represent the spirit of our community.
responsibilities: Photograph workshop sessions, team events, and the flagship event
Deliver edited, high-resolution images for use across all channels
Work with the Design & Media team to meet visual content needs
Maintain an organised archive of all photography assets
Contribute to pre-event and post-event visual storytelling
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Experience in event or portrait photography
Proficiency in photo editing software (Lightroom, Photoshop, or equivalent)
Own camera equipment preferred
Strong eye for composition and detail

roles.title: Media Officer · Videography
roles.description: The Media Officer (Videography) captures and produces video content for TEDxNortheasternU London. You will film and edit highlight reels, behind-the-scenes content, and event documentation to share our story with the wider world.
responsibilities: Film workshop sessions, team moments, and the flagship event
Edit and produce short-form and long-form video content
Create highlight reels and social media video clips
Collaborate with the Marketing and Social Media Officers on content strategy
Maintain an organised archive of all video footage and exports
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Experience filming and editing video content
Proficiency in video editing software (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent)
Own camera or recording equipment preferred
Understanding of social media video formats and aspect ratios

roles.title: Events Officer
roles.description: The Events Officer is responsible for planning and executing the logistics of TEDxNortheasternU London events. From venue coordination to day-of operations, you will ensure every event runs smoothly and leaves a lasting impression on our audience.
responsibilities: Coordinate venue bookings, layouts, and event logistics
Manage supplier and vendor relationships
Prepare run-of-show documents and event briefs
Oversee on-the-day setup, operations, and breakdown
Coordinate with officer teams on staffing and scheduling needs
Support post-event evaluation and debrief
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Experience in event planning or coordination is a plus
Strong project management and problem-solving skills
Calm under pressure and able to adapt quickly
Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple moving parts

roles.title: Operations Officer
roles.description: The Operations Officer ensures TEDxNortheasternU London runs like clockwork behind the scenes. You will manage internal workflows, coordinate team logistics, and support the smooth delivery of both the flagship event and day-to-day organisational operations.
responsibilities: Oversee internal processes and team workflows
Coordinate scheduling and resource allocation across teams
Support the Events Officer with logistical planning
Maintain operational documentation and team handbooks
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks proactively
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Highly organised with strong attention to process
Experience with project management tools is a plus
Collaborative and solutions-focused mindset
Reliable and able to work independently

roles.title: Outreach Officer
roles.description: The Outreach Officer builds and maintains relationships that extend TEDxNortheasternU London’s reach beyond campus. You will connect with external organisations, student groups, and communities to grow our network, attract diverse audiences, and create partnership opportunities.
responsibilities: Identify and approach external organisations and communities for partnership
Maintain relationships with student societies, clubs, and external groups
Represent TEDxNortheasternU London at networking events and panels
Support audience development by extending reach to new communities
Coordinate with the Marketing Officer on outreach campaigns
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Confident communicator with strong interpersonal skills
Experience in community engagement, outreach, or partnerships is a plus
Enthusiastic about building relationships and representing the brand
Self-motivated and able to work with a high degree of autonomy

roles.title: Social Media Officer
roles.description: The Social Media Officer manages the online presence of TEDxNortheasternU London. You will create and schedule content across our social platforms, grow our following, and build an engaged community that reflects the energy and values of our events.
responsibilities: Manage and grow TEDxNortheasternU London’s social media accounts
Plan and execute a content calendar across Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms
Create engaging written and visual content in collaboration with the Media team
Monitor analytics and adapt strategy based on performance
Engage with followers and respond to messages and comments
Cover events live on social media where appropriate
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Active understanding of Instagram and LinkedIn best practices
Creative copywriter with a strong sense of tone and brand voice
Experience managing social media accounts (personal or professional)
Familiar with content scheduling tools (e.g. Later, Buffer, or equivalent)

roles.title: Sponsorship Officer
roles.description: The Sponsorship Officer is responsible for identifying, approaching, and managing relationships with sponsors and partners for TEDxNortheasternU London. You will play a key role in securing the funding and in-kind support that makes our events possible, building lasting partnerships with organisations that share our mission.
responsibilities: Identify and research potential sponsors and partners aligned with our mission
Draft and send sponsorship proposals and outreach communications
Manage ongoing sponsor relationships and ensure expectations are met
Coordinate sponsor deliverables — branding, benefits, event presence
Maintain a pipeline of sponsorship leads and track progress
Support the Treasurer in financial reporting related to sponsorship income
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Strong written communication and negotiation skills
Confident in outreach and building professional relationships
Organised and able to manage a pipeline of contacts
Prior experience in sales, partnerships, or business development is a plus

roles.title: Technology Officer
roles.description: The Technology Officer manages the technology that powers TEDxNortheasternU London — from our website to AV setup at events. You will ensure our digital presence is polished, our event tech runs without a hitch, and the team has the tools it needs to operate effectively.
responsibilities: Maintain and update the TEDxNortheasternU London website
Manage audio-visual setup and technical operations at events
Support the team with digital tools, platforms, and integrations
Troubleshoot technical issues quickly during events
Research and recommend tools to improve team operations
requirements: Currently enrolled at Northeastern University London
Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is essential
Knowledge of other web technologies is a plus
Experience with AV equipment or live event tech is beneficial
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to stay calm under pressure
Proactive and able to work independently
